subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A performer's first public appearance
solution:
The correct answer is: **Debut**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Debut"** means a performer’s first public appearance. (प्रथम प्रदर्शन)
 
 
• **Example:** The young singer made her debut at the concert last night.
 
 

 
• **"Debut" **refers to the occasion when someone performs or presents something to the public for the first time. (प्रथम प्रदर्शन)
 
 
• **Example:** Her debut in the film industry was highly anticipated by her fans.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the word for a performer's first public appearance is **'Debut'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Debut**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Foundation **(आधार): The basis or groundwork of anything.
 
 
• **Example:** Education is the foundation of a successful career.
 
 

 
• **Premise **(परिस्थिति): A previous statement or proposition from which another is inferred or follows as a conclusion.
 
 
• **Example:** The premise of his argument was flawed.
 
 

 
• **Dawn** (भोर): The first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise.
 
 
• **Example:** We woke up at dawn to watch the sunrise.
 
 

128:T71a,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
